facts.business: Agri-Tech (India) Limited is an agricultural technology company.

auditor.name: KP Sahasrabudhe & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-charging of interest on inter-corporate loans/advances, non-compliance with Section 186 of Companies Act 2013 and Ind AS 109 fair valuation requirements; Emphasis of matter on prolonged outstanding loans to related parties dependent on court decision.

key_risks: Inter-corporate loans/advances with no interest charged, matter sub judice before Supreme Court
Prolonged outstanding loans to related parties, recoverability dependent on court decision
Non-compliance with Section 186 of Companies Act 2013 and Ind AS 109
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements with related parties are at arm's length basis. Loans granted to related parties outstanding for prolonged period, considered recoverable by management but ultimate outcome dependent on court decision.
